headline: Donor-aware count, covariance and tail models extend population-scale expression analysis beyond mean abundance
label: Donor Aware Population Expression Modeling
summary: New eQTL, TWAS, fine-mapping and case-control methods model donor structure and count data, with an Alzheimer's atlas of ~4.2M nuclei from 627 donors.
synthesis: The common thread is population-scale expression modeling that respects donor structure and data type. SAIGE-QTL (Poisson mixed model) and jaxQTL (negative binomial pseudobulk) replace linear models for sc-eQTL mapping, with both reporting gains in power or calibration. ATTICUS adds uncertainty-aware personalised prediction to cell-type TWAS, while RSparsePro makes fine-mapping robust to LD reference mismatch. For disease contrasts, IDC uses within-donor gene covariance and TailEnrich tests distribution tails for subset-specific dysregulation, going beyond mean differences. TriSCOPE applies donor-aware modeling across ~4.2M nuclei from 627 donors in Alzheimer's disease. MRGN and scMINA add causal-network inference from trios and interpretable multiome regulatory prioritization.
